concepts.prompt: Using the reference images for palette and style, draft a 3D-model concept of a TIPPED-OVER iron signal brazier after a fight: a village watch brazier (a wide iron fire bowl with a riveted rim on a short three-legged wrought-iron stand) knocked over and lying on its side on the ground, about 1.4 m long lying down, one leg bent. Cold black coals and grey ash spill out of the bowl in a fan shape onto the ground beside it. Weathered dark iron with warm brass rivets, soot staining. No fire, no red, no oxblood, cold and dead. Stylised Palworld / Animo-class game prop, chunky exaggerated readable silhouette that reads clearly from 15 m away, hand-painted PBR look, clean shapes, slightly oversized details. Single isolated object, full object visible and centred, plain neutral background, even lighting, no cast shadow, no ground plane, no people, no creatures, no text.

agent_visual_verdict: Good: riveted dark iron fire bowl with brass rivets lying on its side, bent wrought legs, cold black coals and grey ash spilling out in a fan; reads tipped-over and dead. No red.
notes: Concept views 0-2 all used. Interior of bowl is plain soot-dark; coal pile is fused to the mesh.
